feladatok.cim: Message answering an ad for a dog walker
feladatok.helyzet: You are in the USA, taking part in a language course in a small town called Greenford. In an Internet Forum you find the following advertisement:

bekezdesek: Would you like to make a little extra money?
We are looking for someone in Greenford to take our two dogs for a walk every afternoon.
Interested? Please drop me a message here.

feladatok.teendo: Write a message of 50 words including the following:
iranyito_szempontok: ask about the exact time and length of the walks
ask how much you would be paid

feladatok.cim: Report on the snowfall on 15 March
feladatok.helyzet: You are a regular reader of an Internet forum on unusual weather. Readers are asked to add a report to the collection, so you decide to write about the snowfall in March. Here are your notes about what happened:

bekezdesek: 8.00 a.m. Buses and trains 30-40 minutes late
